title: Investigating the potent antimicrobial properties of a supramolecular Zn(II)-metallogel formed from an isophthalic acid-based low molecular weight gelator
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27544-27550
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03663A, Paper

Subhendu Dhibar, Sangita Some, Suchetana Pal, Rajlakshmi Laha, Priya Kaith, Aditi Trivedi, Subham Bhattacharjee, Lebea N. Nthunya, Timothy O. Ajiboye, Sumit Kumar Panja, Asit Kumar Das, Ashok Bera, Somasri Dam, Bidyut Saha
Supramolecular Zn(II)-metallogels, formed using the low molecular weight gelator isophthalic acid, demonstrate strong antibacterial activity against both Gram-positive and Gram-negative bacteria.
